findings.description: The customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the logs bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, so it defaults to false and the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the window of exposure if the key is ever compromised and violates common cryptographic key-lifecycle requirements for regulated data such as audit logs.

deletion_window_in_days is set to the minimum of 7 days, giving only a brief period to detect and cancel a malicious or accidental key deletion; once the key is destroyed all data encrypted with it (including the log bucket objects) becomes permanently unrecoverable, so this is a destructive-action exposure rather than a pure availability concern.
